scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Is your child memorising the Quran?
Each day, your child learns a new lesson, called sabaq.
And each day they revise what they learned before, called muraja'ah.
scenes.say: And each day they revise what they learned before, called muraajaah.

scenes.sub: The report shows the verse reached and what to practise before the next class.
Every teacher is approved by our Head of Academics, a Hafiza of the Quran.
